calls.video_title: Sold Out Until 2029. The Stock Is Still Falling.
calls.thesis: Guest Lucas Downey (TradeSmith) is bullish on Lumentum as a buy-the-dip AI optics leader: CEO says optical components for AI servers are sold out through early 2029, forward P/E has contracted to ~35x as earnings estimates rise while the price falls, and he 'would not be too scared to dip toes' into it after a ~15% one-week fall.
calls.base_case: Sales seen rising from just over $3bn (last 12 months) to ~$6.3bn next 12 months and ~$10bn the year after; FY27 EPS expected ~$21.70, more than doubling by FY29.
calls.bear_case: Admits more downward pressure is possible near-term; bottom judged days to a couple of weeks away, not confirmed.

calls.thesis: Highest risk/reward of the five: AI optical bottleneck (1.6T modules, optical circuit switching); size lightly.
calls.base: Next-year EPS expected +150% to $18.58; PEG < 1 even at 58x fwd PE.
calls.bear: Up 560% in 12 months at an all-time high — expect big volatility.

calls.thesis: Preferred networking play (Lumentum, optics/photonics); copper-to-fiber upgrade cycle plus data-center networking demand; consolidating at highs before a breakout, 50-70% upside if macro headwinds clear.
calls.bull_case: One-two punch of networking buildout and copper-to-optics upgrades; EPS estimates rising through 2028.
calls.bear_case: Macro chop: 10-year at 5.3% pressures multiples despite strong fundamentals.
